versions.changelog:
Initial release of the buyback-screen skill.

- Screens A-share companies (Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing) with recent buyback announcements.
- Supports filtering by PE (TTM), PB, market cap, buyback amount, purpose, progress, and more.
- Outputs detailed tables and exports results as TSV files.
- Data sourced from Eastmoney Data Center APIs; requires internet access.
- Focuses on practical use cases such as large buybacks, low-valuation screens, and scenario-based company selections.
